expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked login'; } return 'no login button'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'title=' + t.includes('Agent Mesh') + ';edgeSim=' + t.includes('edge-sim') + ';darkSite=' + t.includes('dark-site') + ';upBadge=' + (t.match(/UP/g) || []).length + ';downBadge=' + (t.match(/DOWN/g) || []).length + ';counts=' + (t.includes('TOTAL') && t.includes('UNKNOWN')) + ';hashedKeyIcon=' + t.includes('API key registered') ; })()

(() => { const i = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Peer name"]'); if (!i) return 'name input missing'; const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(i, 'staging'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'name set to staging'; })()

(() => { const i = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Peer base URL"]'); if (!i) return 'url input missing'; const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(i, 'http://localhost:4999'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'url set'; })()

(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => (x.textContent || '').trim().includes('Add peer')); if (!b) return 'add button missing'; b.click(); return 'clicked Add peer'; })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'stagingRow=' + t.includes('staging') + ';stagingDown=' + t.includes('DOWN') + ';toast=' + (t.includes('registered') ? 'yes' : 'no'); })()
